---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[FEATURE] - "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
type: Feature

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. 
*Ex. "I'm always frustrated when trying to map keys in arcade games..." or "I wish the MinUI interface had a way to..."*

**Target Area: Main UI (MinUI) or a specific Emulator/Core?**
Let us know if this is a general system feature (e.g., main menu, sleep mode, networking, NekoBit) or if it applies to a specific console/emulator (e.g., only for PS1, GBA, DOSBox-Pure).

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. How would this look or behave in the MiaUI interface? Keep in mind our minimalist and distraction-free philosophy!

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, third-party apps, or how other CFWs (like original MinUI, GarlicOS, Koriki) handle this feature.

**Additional context**
Add any other context here. Mockup images, GIFs (showing a proof of concept), or short videos are highly appreciated! If your request is related to a specific game or core setting, please mention it.
